purpose: Reproduce the observed caller-module name compatibility condition during native NR initialization

provenance.embedded_signer: NVIDIA Corporation; signature does not validate the current bytes
provenance.runtime_verified_hardware: RTX 4080 SUPER: initialization, feature creation and retirement; evaluation NOT RUN
provenance.acceptance_basis: Exact SHA-256 match to supplied community build; never publisher-name-only trust
provenance.redistribution: Not established; runtime remains local and excluded from shipping

original: ASLR-normalized pointer: must equal GetProcAddress(kernel32.dll, GetModuleFileNameW) in this process
replacement: callerNameProxy in RazKolbasNrBootstrapProbe; substitutes nvngx.dll only for the probe executable's module handle
abi: DWORD WINAPI(HMODULE, LPWSTR, DWORD); naturally aligned 8-byte pointer CAS; no instruction relocation
activation: Standalone probe only, after exact-hash runtime load and before Init_Ext; proxy state is immutable and code stays alive until process exit
rollback: Compare-and-exchange only while slot still equals our proxy; restore before FreeLibrary; on ownership conflict do not unload runtime or override new owner
